data.long_meaning: Monjit is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'monj', meaning 'protector'. The suffix 'it' denotes the one who has the power to protect. In Hindu mythology, Monjit is the deity who is believed to protect the universe and its inhabitants. The name is also associated with courage, strength, and wisdom. The name Monjit carries the meaning “Protector of the universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Monjit usually hope their child will grow to embody protector of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
